Barrier Quirk.name: Barrier Quirk
Barrier Quirk.description:
🛡️ You project flat, clear panels of force that stop what hits them.

🌱 At the start you snap a door-sized panel into an attack's path or slam it into an attacker, and hold a dome over yourself and the people beside you.
📈 With training: villains boxed in, falls caught on slanted panes, panel stairs, walls against crowds, floods or collapses, blasts turned aside, a dome over a city block.
⚠️ Every barrier shatters if it takes more than you can hold.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding a barrier burns your body's strength.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kosei Tsuburaba (Solid Air), Crust (Shield).

📈 Grants: Endurance +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Evacuation +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Stopgap Pane, Shelter Dome
Barrier Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: flat, clear force panels, or a curved dome, anywhere in sight within about five meters. A new adult user raises a door-sized panel in a blink, or a dome over themselves and two or three people, held while focused. It stops fists, blades, debris and handgun rounds; a speeding car or heavy Quirk blow shatters it. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: a new user's barriers stay put and cannot form inside an object or body, so never cut; heat, light and sound pass through; all vanish if the user is knocked out or suppressed. Quirk Strain: light: a panel; moderate: dome over a few people, cage, catching slope, stair; heavy: street-wide wall, deflecting an attack; severe: signature dome, shells around a crowd. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed walling people in or blocking roads or exits is unlawful confinement; whoever traps people in danger answers for what happens. Look: clear panes edged in the player's color, rippling when hit, bursting into flakes.
